principles: Source text is authoritative. Metadata is secondary and never justifies altering the text.
If a value cannot be supported by the text or the source document, leave it empty or use 'Not specified'. Do not guess.

Every value carries provenance: source (stated in the document), computed (derived by a script), ai (suggested by an AI model), or human (entered or confirmed by a reviewer). Human values are never overwritten.
Every AI value carries a confidence (high, medium, low) and one sentence of evidence that points to the text.
The library records what sources state. It never asserts that a piece is legal or eligible for any league.

record_type.label: Record type
record_type.definition: What kind of record this is.
record_type.assign_when: Cutting for a single performed selection; Program for a POI with several selections; Unsegmented Text when a file could not be split.
record_type.do_not_assign_when: Do not use Program for a single-source cutting.

values.Cutting: One performable cutting of a published work.
values.Program: A program built from several selections (POI).
values.Unsegmented Text: Text that could not be split into cuttings and needs a person.

record_status.label: Record status
record_status.definition: Whether the record appears in the library.

values.Archived: Hidden but kept in the database.

event.label: Event
event.definition: The interpretation event the cutting was prepared for, as the uploader filed it.
event.assign_when: The event is stated in the filing or the source.
event.do_not_assign_when: Do not infer the event from the text.
examples: File in a folder named 'Any Gender DI': Dramatic Interpretation.

values.Program Oral Interpretation: Thematic program of two or more genres.
values.Not specified: The uploader did not file it under an event.

literary_form.label: Literary form of the source work
literary_form.definition: The form of the published work the cutting comes from.
literary_form.assign_when: The form is stated in the source or evident from the text layout (stage directions and speaker labels mean Drama; lineated verse means Poetry).
literary_form.do_not_assign_when: Do not assign from tone or topic.
examples: Speaker labels and stage directions: Drama.

values.Nonfiction: Essay, memoir, journalism, transcript or other factual writing.
values.Mixed: More than one form in the cutting.
values.Not specified: The form cannot be determined from the record.

tone.label: Overall tone
tone.definition: The overall register of the cutting, distinct from the specific emotions played.
tone.assign_when: The register is evident from word choice and situation.
tone.do_not_assign_when: Do not list emotions; do not assign from the topic alone.
examples: A comic account of a funeral: Lighthearted, Ironic.

values.Ironic: Meaning differs from the surface statement.
values.Satirical: Mocks people, institutions or customs to criticise them.

content_warnings.label: Content warnings
content_warnings.definition: Sensitive content that is present in the cutting text.
content_warnings.assign_when: The text contains or directly describes the content.
content_warnings.do_not_assign_when: Do not assign for a topic mentioned only in the introduction or the source block.
examples: A narrator describes a shooting: Violence, Death, War/Trauma.

values.Death: A death occurs or is described.
values.Violence: Physical violence occurs or is described.
values.Abuse: Physical, emotional or sexual abuse of a person.
values.War/Trauma: War, mass violence or traumatic events.

difficulty.label: Difficulty
difficulty.definition: How demanding the cutting is to perform well.
difficulty.assign_when: Sustained demands are evident (many characters, dialect, wide emotional range).
difficulty.do_not_assign_when: Do not assign from length alone.

values.Advanced: Many characters, rapid shifts, dialect or a very wide emotional range.

performance_demands.label: Performance demands
performance_demands.assign_when: The text clearly requires it (many labelled speakers, written dialect, stated physical business).
performance_demands.do_not_assign_when: Do not assign for one speaker with one voice.

values.Vocal Variety: Wide vocal range or rapid pacing changes.
values.Dialect: A dialect is stated or written.
values.Pacing/Timing Control: Pauses, beats or rhythm drive the piece.

audience_level.label: Suggested audience level
audience_level.definition: A suggestion only, never a claim of appropriateness.
audience_level.assign_when: Judged from content warnings and complexity; always labelled AI-suggested.
audience_level.do_not_assign_when: Do not assign when content warnings have not been assessed.

values.High School: Suitable for general high school use.

rights_status.label: Rights status
rights_status.definition: What is known about permission to host this cutting.
rights_status.assign_when: Only a reviewer sets Permission on file or Public domain (per source), and records the basis in rights_note.

values.Public domain (per source): The source states it is public domain.
values.Removal requested: A takedown request is pending; the record is hidden.

duplicate_status.label: Duplicate status
duplicate_status.assign_when: Exact: identical spoken words. Near: same piece with small differences.
duplicate_status.do_not_assign_when: Other cuttings of the same source work are not duplicates.

values.Related Version: Another cut of the same piece.

source_citation.label: Source citation in the file
source_citation.definition: How completely the file cites its published source.
source_citation.assign_when: Complete: a publisher and an ISBN or date are given. Partial: some are given. Not stated: neither.
source_citation.do_not_assign_when: Does not say the source is eligible for any league.

values.Complete: Publisher and ISBN or date stated.

values.Verified: A person has checked the record.
values.Missing Metadata: Title, author or work is not specified.

intro_boundary.label: Introduction boundary
intro_boundary.definition: How the split between introduction and performance text was found.

values.High: Font change and a 'Title by Author' line agree.
values.Medium: Font change only, hand-checked or flagged for checking.

free_text_fields.themes: Short noun phrases for what the cutting is about. Only themes the text supports.
free_text_fields.subject_matter: One sentence describing what happens in the cutting.

timing_note: Run-time estimates and league timing flags are not part of this library (director's decision, 2026-09-30). Word counts are kept.
